title: Dean says ‘Pennsylvania deserves better’ as she mulls challenging Fetterman
summary: Rep. Madeleine Dean (D-Pa.) said she believed “Pennsylvania deserves better” amid speculation that she may launch a Senate bid in 2028 for Sen. John Fetterman’s (D-Pa.) seat. title: Mamdani recovering after ‘successful’ Achilles surgery
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is recovering at Gracie Mansion—the mayor’s official residence—following a “successful” surgery on his injured Achilles, which was caused by a recreational soccer game earlier this month. “Today, Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani underwent a surgical procedure to repair his Achilles tendon,” Joe Calvello, Mamdani’s press secretary, said in a statement. …

title: Texas AG-elect won’t defend Ten Commandments classroom law
